coverage: All 28 Indian states and eight union territories. Selected established regional and Indigenous language communities; very small groups and a census-wide migrant-language inventory are outside scope. Attested state-name forms are distinguished from language-presence entries. Romanized traditional forms are explicitly marked. This is not an official-language register or a claim of exhaustive dialect coverage.
